job_application.quote: You have to regularly report, to which companies you wrote job applications.

job_offer.quote: Based on your job applications, new potential job offers are sent to you.

job_interview.quote: A job interview can be negotiated.

job.precondition: job_offer.sent AND job_interview.negotiated AND job_application.rated AND job_application.in_probation AND job_application.rated_by_applicant AND job_application.rated_by_company
job.quote: When a company wants you to work for them, you enter the probation phase. After probation phase, you can rate the company and the company can rate you.

review.precondition: job_application.rated_by_applicant AND job_application.rated_by_company AND job_application.in_probation AND job_application.rated_by_applicant AND job_application.rated_by_company AND (job_application.rated_by_applicant OR job_application.rated_by_company) AND NOT job.permanent
quote: After probation phase, you can rate the company and the company can rate you.
If a job becomes permanent, the process ends, unless you rated the company C or less, then you continue to receive job offers, but no longer have to report.
